content.title: This Building Stock Had Its Best Day in Months. Why Shares Rose.
content.summary: Shares of  Quanex Building Products  logged their largest same-day percentage increase in months after the small-cap manufacturing company swung to a profit in its fiscal fourth quarter.  The company’s performance appeared more related to business practices than a shift in housing market or macroeconomic prospects.  The turnaround drove shares 9.6% higher to $16.52 on Friday afternoon, Quanex’s biggest percentage increase since June, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
